questions_and_answers.question_text: What is fázi, and where is it used?
What is the Běijīng pronunciation of "painting"?
Write the Chinese for "I spend four hours in the library every day."
Write the Chinese for "There's no way I can sit in the library for four hours."

answers.answer_text: Wǒ méiyou fázi zài túshūguǎn zuò sìge zhōngtóu.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "please have a seat."
Which expression means "there's no way to…"?
What does the verb zuò mean here?

articles.text:
Notes on Additional Required Vocabulary

8.  fāngfǎ       method, way, means
9.  fázi         method, way
10. huàr         painting (Běijīng pronunciation)
11. qǐng zuò     please have a seat
12. shèhuìxué    sociology
13. túshūguǎn    library
14. zuò          to sit

Here are a few sentences illustrating some of the words:

Nǐde shèhuìxué xuéde zhènme      You learned your sociology so well!
hǎo! Nǐ yòng shénme fāngfǎ       How do you study it?
niànde?
Měitian zài túshūguǎn sìge       I spend four hours in the library
zhōngtóu.                        every day.
Ài! Wǒ méiyou fázi zài           Boy! There's no way I can sit in
túshūguǎn zuò sìge               the library for four hours.
zhōngtóu.
